title: VirtualJoystick does not update visibility mode until touched by the user
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7-dev1, 4.7-dev2.
- Not applicable prior to 4.7 (new feature).

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9571) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 15.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

Changing the `visibility_mode` of a `VirtualJoystick` does not actually take effect until the next time the user interacts with the joystick.

Changing it from `ALWAYS` to `WHEN_TOUCHED` doesn't hide the joystick until the user touches it once, then it gets hidden properly. And the other way around.

See this video of the MRP:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/23b346ef-f5f1-4b49-853c-c27aaee6eb17

Note about why this is important: I have a game where I want to have the joystick set to `WHEN_TOUCHED` usually, so the joystick does not clutter up the screen. But for the tutorial that teaches the player how to move, I want to briefly set it to `ALWAYS` so they can see the joystick on screen, then set it to `WHEN_TOUCHED` again after the tutorial is complete. I currently have no way to dynamically change the mode, and requiring the user to touch it before it appears defeats the point of the tutorial which is to show the user that it exists.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Turn on project setting `input_devices/pointing/emulate_touch_from_mouse` (or just use a touch screen).
2. Create a `VirtualJoystick`.
3. Optionally change `joystick_mode` to dynamic (not needed but makes it easier to use).
4. Create a checkbox/button that, when toggled, switches the joystick's `visibility_mode`.
5. Run the project and play with the checkbox and joystick.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[virtualjoystick-visibility-demo.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25830904/virtualjoystick-visibility-demo.zip)
